root_cause: Route animations tick inside run_frame, after the outlet rebuild, so a popped route whose reverse animation finishes on a frame is dropped only on the next frame.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/route_outlet.rs: exit pruning extracted to retain_unfinished_exits (behavior unchanged). An attempted same-frame settle (tick before rebuild) was reverted: it did not clear the divergence.
tests: crates/incular/tests/heroes.rs::heroes_do_not_fly_without_a_route_animation_or_on_pop: FAILING at line 391 (source hero not painted after the reverse completes; left [] right [10,10,30,30]); not caused by the outlet change, the hero test harness does not use RouteOutlet; cause not isolated in this pass
harness: navigation__navigator__fade_pop_timeline: probe.top.present still differs at frame 44 (Flutter false, Incular true). navigation__hero__pop_flight_navigator: same frame-44 lag plus hero_to/hero_from opacity and rect diverge from frame 3-4.
limitations: One-frame removal lag remains; hero pop flight geometry differs from Flutter. Needs a runtime tick-before-build ordering change, outside this group.

root_cause: PageRouteBuilder defaulted to no transition and used no reverse duration, so default page routes did not animate.
change: crates/incular-navigation/src/presentation.rs: default 300 ms forward and reverse durations, transitions_builder, and build() yields an Animated RouteAnimation when no explicit transition is set.
limitations: The declarative Page default is still RouteTransition::None (residual).

root_cause: Exiting routes were removed too early or kept occluding; fade pages hid the route below before the fade completed.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/route_outlet.rs: transition_settled gates occlusion on the transition; pop reverses through reverse_on_next_tick for route-animation routes; exiting routes stay mounted until dismissed.
harness: navigation frame scenarios: fade pop shows one-frame late removal versus Flutter
limitations: One-frame removal lag remains (dismissal ticked in frame N, outlet drops in frame N+1).

root_cause: Imperative route removal was missing; only pop existed.
change: crates/incular-navigation/src/navigator.rs: remove_route, remove_route_below, pop_until, push_and_remove_until; removal reports Popped and ActiveRouteChanged.

root_cause: Surface partitions (open popups) were culled by ancestor clips before being lifted out.
change: crates/incular-rendering/src/compositor.rs: flatten_layer drops the ancestor clip for partitions before the cull block.
harness: navigation__overlay_portal__content_outside_anchor_clip: content matches; anchor probe still diverges (see navigation-009). Pixel scene overlay_portal_ancestor_clip (1x and 1.5x) is pending the orchestrator.

root_cause: OverlayPortal's outer stacks were Loose, so the anchor received loosened constraints and a tight parent did not size it, unlike Flutter where OverlayPortal passes its constraints to the child unchanged.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/navigation_scopes.rs: both outer stacks (shown and hidden) use StackFit::Passthrough; the anchor keeps the caller key through the keyed Passthrough anchor_wrapper.
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/overlay_tooltip_lifecycle.rs (22 pass; 6 tests moved to a loose root via loose_root/mount_loose)
limitations: none recorded for the probe; the 6 overlay_tooltip_lifecycle expectations were updated, see the md section.
note: Test update justified: these tests mount tiny anchors under a tight 200x200 or 120x120 root and expected content-sized anchors. Flutter gives such an anchor the tight root size, so the tests now wrap their root in Align(topLeft), which gives loose constraints, as an app would.

root_cause: ModalRoute scopes are environment_scope nodes that are built lazily, so with the scope enabled by default the route content is validated after the rebuild commits. That breaks the atomic failure contract (duplicate-key rebuild must fail before any commit).
change: none (modal_route_scopes stays opt-in, default false, in route_outlet.rs)
limitations: Blocker: eager validation of the scope requires building environment_scope children during the outlet rebuild. That change is in incular-widgets tree reconciliation, outside this group.

root_cause: RouteOutlet rejects routes that present overlay entries by design (OutletPlacement::ExternalOverlay, UnsupportedPresentation); overlay entries are meant to be hosted by an OverlayPortal the application owns.
limitations: Re-assessed: supporting them means the outlet hosts overlay layering (barrier and z-order) inside navigation, a navigation/widgets design boundary decision. Remains deferred.

root_cause: Overlay state had no change notification, so a host build that read entries never rebuilt after insert or remove; per-entry removal existed but was not observable.
change: crates/incular-navigation/src/presentation.rs: Overlay holds a DependencySource; entries() and blocks_background_input() track it; insert, insert_above/below, remove and remove_top notify it (remove_top and remove only when something was removed).
limitations: Rebuild is the host's: an application host must read Overlay::entries in a build. No built-in Overlay host widget exists in this group.

root_cause: Router needs a child dispatcher API.
limitations: Deferred: API too large for this group.

root_cause: AnimatedModalBarrier could not express a null color endpoint, so fading to no fill was impossible.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/navigation/barrier.rs: OptionalColorAnimation (sampler closure, since Option<Color> cannot implement the local Tween trait); AnimatedModalBarrier::animation() now returns OptionalColorAnimation (API change).
